bio: Casa Brito is famous on the island both for its cooking, which is traditional and superbly prepared, and the high level of service provided by its staff, who are friendly and used to working with a local clientele. The set-up here includes a private bar and two rustically inspired dining rooms, the main one of which has an open grill and wood ceilings. The speciality here is the perfectly cooked grilled beef from Germany, Uruguay and the Spanish regions of Castilla, Galicia and Asturias. The barbecued chorizo and the delicious grilled chops of young Baifo goat (the island’s native species) are also well worth trying....
